title: Define schema-validated review feedback
summary: Add a multi-file feedback format and CLI for batches, targeted comments, submission, resolution, and approvals.
rationale: Review comments evolve independently from implementation evidence, so they need a separate mutable graph with strict references back to requirements, stages, context items, files, and lines.

decisions.summary: Store mutable review feedback under .semantic-review-feedback instead of the canonical implementation artifact.
decisions.rationale: Comments, submission, and approvals change frequently and version 0.1 deliberately excludes them from immutable stage descriptions.

decisions.summary: Use one manifest, one file per batch, and one file per feedback item.
decisions.rationale: Reviewers and agents can update one comment or batch without rewriting a shared monolith, while tools load everything from explicit indexes.

decisions.summary: Freeze comment body and target after batch submission.
decisions.rationale: The agent needs a stable instruction set; corrections should be new comments rather than silent mutation of submitted feedback.

decisions.summary: Allow draft comments to be edited, deleted, and assigned before submission.
decisions.rationale: The reviewer needs to refine a batch freely; body and target immutability begins only when submission freezes the instruction set.

risks.summary: A line number can move when earlier stage feedback rewrites history.
risks.mitigation: Anchor line comments to a stage ID, commit, path, side, and line; show them as stale if the stage commit changes before resolution.

validation.summary: Covers schema validation, multi-target comments, submission, stage rewrite resolution, individual and batch approval, and PR branch gating.
Covers draft editing, deletion, stage assignment, and semantic-order next-stage JSON output.
